needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-16), sibling to gse-256490-brain-vasculature-scrnaseq -- see that record's needs_manual_review_reason for the full pan-atlas/scope-caveat reasoning shared by both, closing out the same coverage_gaps.md-carried lead ('GSE256490-GSE256493 ... Not yet checked'). This is the bulk RNA-seq subseries of the same pan-CNS-vasculature atlas (GSE256493 SuperSeries), FACS-sorted CD31+/CD45- endothelial cells from the same disease categories. scripts/extract_gsm_characteristics.py's per-sample fallback found 6 of 31 samples in GSE256492 labeled 'Meningioma' in the per-GSM 'genotype' field, one sample per patient (MEN_patient1 through MEN_patient6 per each sample's own 'treatment' field/title) -- all FACS-sorted EC-only, no unsorted 'all cells' arm in this bulk subseries. Note this is 6 patients, one more than the scRNA-seq sibling's 5 -- MEN_patient6 has a bulk RNA-seq sample but no corresponding scRNA-seq sample in GSE256490, confirmed by checking GSE256490 has no patient6 entry. Whether patients 1-5 here are the exact same individuals as patients 1-5 in the scRNA-seq arm cannot be confirmed from GEO metadata alone (no shared patient-ID field, only matching sequential naming), so paired_multimodal.is_paired is set true on the strength of same-cohort/same-paper/same-naming-convention evidence, not a confirmed shared patient-ID linkage -- flagged here rather than silently assumed as certain. Publication (PMID 38987604, Nature 2024) verified via PubMed esummary; corresponding author (Thomas Wälchli) confirmed via the same PMC full-text correspondence-footnote check as the scRNA-seq sibling record. No series-level processed expression matrix is listed among this series' GEO supplementary files (only raw FASTQ via SRA per sample), so processed_data_available reflects that the linked publication's own downstream processed outputs, if any, are not deposited at the series level here. No per-sample sex/age/grade/anatomic-location/treatment-timing data exists in the GSM metadata, so those fields correctly remain 'Not reported'.
